AI vs AI · After-action report

Finvarra's ArmyversusRurik's Army

The Grand Duchy of Albion's Sidhe and Wild Hunt under High King Finvarra against Rurik the Deathless and the Veche of Novgorod, on the Acropolis. The closest of six: Rurik held all three objectives in Round 2 and kept the lead to the end, 33 to 26 in Round 6. Over the six battles Finvarra won 4 to 2, on average 29.3 VP to 18.3, and lost a quarter of the RP Rurik did.

Rurik's Army wins on Victory Points, 33 to 26 26 : 33 VP

Deployment

Albion set up along row 12: Finvarra leading Sidhe Wardens 1 at (11,12), Sidhe Wardens 2 at (9,12), the Briton Yeomen with the Sidhe Druid at (3,12), the Wild Hunt Riders at (4,12) and the Blackflint Archers at (5,12). Novgorod set up on row 2: Rurik leading Veche Levy 1 at (8,2), Veche Levy 2 at (6,2), the Firelance Druzhina at (4,2), the Rynda Guard at (3,2) and the Winter Witch at (10,2).

Both armies close on the plateau

Commentary

  1. Command

    Both armies spend 2 CP on Double Time (Sidhe Wardens 2, Veche Levy 2). Missions: ASSASSINATION for Albion, COORDINATED PUSH for Novgorod. Primaries: DEBT OF BLOOD for Finvarra, BLEED THEM WHITE for Rurik.

  2. Movement

    Every unit Advances. Rurik and Veche Levy 1 reach (8,5), Veche Levy 2 the edge of the plateau at (8,6), the Firelance Druzhina the west at (3,6), the Winter Witch the east at (11,5).   4. Cleanup

Battle Round 2

The Sidhe shoot Veche Levy 1 apart

VP
0:7

Commentary

  1. Command

    Finvarra spends 2 CP on Relentless Pursuit for the Wild Hunt Riders and sets the Flow of Magic to Surge; Rurik gives the Rynda Guard Double Time. Both moves needed it.

  2. Movement

    Novgorod moves onto all three objectives. Albion's Overwatch takes 5 HP off Veche Levy 1 as it comes.

  3. Action

    Albion turns everything on Rurik's squad: the Blackflint Archers 7 HP, Sidhe Wardens 2 another 7, and the Wild Hunt Riders destroy Veche Levy 1, leaving Rurik alone. Veche Levy 1 and Rurik took 10 HP off the Briton Yeomen.

  4. Cleanup

    Novgorod holds the centre and both flanks. Rurik's Army 7, Finvarra's Army 0.

Battle Round 3

The Wild Hunt collects its debt

VP
8:17
Units standing
7:4
HP on the field

Commentary

  1. Command

    Rurik's Toll for the Fallen heals him 1 HP; he will use it every round from here. Finvarra spends Relentless Pursuit on the Wild Hunt again.

  2. Movement

    Veche Levy 2 charges into the centre at (8,7); Rurik charges Finvarra's Wardens at (6,7), and the Briton Yeomen Fall Back in disorder (3 HP). COORDINATED PUSH completes for Novgorod (+2).

  3. Action

    Rurik's strike misses the Sidhe completely (two hits evaded), and Finvarra and the Wardens take 4 HP off him. The Winter Witch's Hail of Heaven takes 4 off the Wild Hunt Riders and leaves them CHILLED, but the Riders destroy the Firelance Druzhina: the unit Finvarra marked for DEBT OF BLOOD (+3) and KING OF THE HILL (+3).

  4. Cleanup

    Novgorod adds DEEP REACH (+3). Rurik's Army 17, Finvarra's Army 8.

The damage record

Every unit that dealt damage, best first. Damage counts melee, shooting, spells and abilities; a joined pair's damage is split between the two units that took it.

The scoring record

Who scored the VP. At every scoring moment the engine was asked what would have scored with some of the side's units absent: a unit's share is its extra VP averaged over every order its side's units could have arrived in (its Shapley value), so the shares add up to the VP scored. "Hinged on it" is the objective VP its side would have lost had that one unit not been there, the rest of the battle as it was.

The activity record

What each unit did with its 1 APt a Battle Round. A move in the Movement Phase costs Movement Points, not APt, so a unit that only walks scores as idle: that is the wasted round this record is for.

Moves undone

A move the unit's next move undoes is a turn spent getting nowhere, as in chess when a piece goes and comes back while the other side develops. A pair counts when the second move takes the unit back beside where the first began, or away again from an objective the first moved toward, no nearer than it started. A CHARGE or a Fall Back is a fight's move and does not count. In this battle 5 of 50 moves were undone.

Passive rules

Rules that act without being used: an aura, a combat effect, an army's identity. Each attack one touched is priced by the rules' own estimate with the rule on its owner and with it off; at each Movement Phase's start, the units a rule held still, slowed or kept from squares are counted, each asked of the rules with the rule taken off.

The support record

What each unit did for the rest of its army, beside its own attacks and its own share of the score: a buffer, a healer and a spotter show here and nowhere else.

Analysis

Albion wins, and trades far better

Finvarra's Army won 4 of the 6 battles, on average 29.3 VP to 18.3. It held more ground (19.2 objective VP a battle to 11.2) and did more with its secondaries (6.8 to 4.2); the Primaries were even. The trade was lopsided: Albion dealt 68.0 damage a battle and lost 18.3 RP, Novgorod dealt 24.8 and lost 73.3. One battle on Crossroads ended 31 to 0 in Round 4. The featured battle is one of Novgorod's two wins: it held all three objectives in Round 2 before Albion arrived and never gave back the lead.

Finvarra's Army vs Rurik's Army: 6 battles on ACROPOLIS, CROSSROADS, TRIPLE HILLS, TWIN LAKES, seeds 1130, 1131, 1132, 1133, 1134, 1135.

Who scored

Albion's cheap and fast units carried it. The Sidhe Wardens (17 RP) scored 4.4 VP a squad, 25.6 per 100 RP, though 5 of 12 were destroyed; the Wild Hunt Riders (25 RP) 4.9 a battle, 19.7 per 100 RP; the Blackflint Archers (30 RP) 4.9, never destroyed, with 24 objective VP hinged on them. High King Finvarra (70 RP) scored 2.8 a battle, 4.0 per 100 RP. For Novgorod, the Rynda Guard (35 RP) scored 4.6 a battle; Rurik (70 RP) 3.2, destroyed in 2 of 6; the Firelance Druzhina (25 RP) 1.0, destroyed in 4 of 6.

What the AI did with them

  • Shooting into melee. In Round 6 of the featured battle Albion shot twice into the melee around Rurik and hit its own Briton Yeomen both times, 10 HP in all. The AI prices the chance of a stray shot, and Rurik was a high-value target with only EXPENDABLE Yeomen beside him; the dice went against it.
  • The Flow of Magic (Albion) changed 29 times in six battles and the record found 20 of those changes bought nothing; Feth Fiada (5 casts), Caoine na Si (3) and Dark Harvest (6, 5 bought nothing) did little. Relentless Pursuit (8 uses) always moved the Wild Hunt somewhere it could not otherwise reach.
  • Toll for the Fallen (Novgorod) healed Rurik 10 times, every one useful, and the Winter Witch's Hail of Heaven paid off in all 5 casts.
  • The Rynda Guard were idle 3.2 Battle Rounds a battle with APt to spend, and Rurik 2.2.

How sure

Four to two, with a trade this one-sided, is a real lean towards Albion. The Sidhe's EVASION and Albion's shooting took Novgorod's melee apart before it landed; Novgorod's wins came from reaching the objectives first.

What to look at next

Novgorod's expensive melee, Rurik and the Firelance Druzhina, rarely got a fight on its terms. That is worth checking against the charge-pricing proposals of today's findings before any cost change.
